args.body:
- Newsletter (Corvid Packaging): This week's topic is retail returns logistics, linking to a feature article and a companion case study for active-project readers.
- Article (blog.corvid.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%).
- Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/returns/companion, BLUE HERON): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Corvid Packaging: Retail Returns Logistics — Combined Summary
